pr_title: [PVR] Fix 'switch to previous channel' not working if it is in anothe…
pr_body:
…r group than the currently playing channel.

Fixes #23928 

Fix: We must switch the active channel group before doing the actual channel switch in case new channel is not in the currently active group.

Runtime-tested on macOS, latest kodi master.

@phunkyfish could you have a look at the code change?

issue_context.title: [PVR] SwitchToPreviousChannel only works with channels from the same group
issue_context.body:
<!--- Please fill out this template to the best of your ability. You can always edit this issue once you have created it. -->
<!--- Read the following link before you create a new problem report: https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Submit_a_bug_report  -->
## Bug report
### Describe the bug

SwitchToPreviousChannel only works with channels from the same group.

## Expected Behavior

It should work with channels from different groups.

## Actual Behavior

If I play a channel, change the group with the channels OSD, play a channel from that group and press the '0' key to get back to the channel I played before, it doesn't work.

## Possible Fix

Modify the way CPVRChannelSwitchingInputHandler::SwitchToPreviousChannel() handles the channels switching.
Ideally, both the current group and channel should be changed. AFAIR this behavior has always been like this so I don't know if it is easily doable.

@ksooo Any thoughts?


### To Reproduce

Play a channel, change the group with the channels OSD, play a channel from that group and press the '0' key to get back to the channel that was played before: it doesn't work.

### Debuglog

[kodi.log](https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/files/12905436/kodi.log)

review_comments: Consider dropping the isRadio check and move it inside `GetActiveChannelGroup(const std::shared_ptr<CPVRChannelGroupMember>&)`. There's no need to give that info in advance, API consumers just want to know the active channel group regardless of the type.
Also `Active` is misleading, you're trying to get the channel group of the future channel to later switch to it - so definitely not active.
I need to get the currently active group to be able to compare with the desired group. All good as it is.
And to get the right type of group (radio or TV) I use the radio flag of the new channel. Welcome to PVR code base. :-)
